title: San Francisco Private Intro Tour with a Local – Custom & Flexible
includes: Online questionnaire link sent after booking to tailor your experience and match you to a local host
Flexible start times - Pick your preferred time when you book
Get picked up (on foot) at your accommodation if it's central!
Private and personalized walking experience with insider tips from a passionate local
Direct communication with your host for itinerary planning and local recommendations
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This is a private City Unscripted experience: real people, real connections

After booking, you'll receive a short online questionnaire to share your interests, preferences, and must-sees. Your City Unscripted guide will personally reach out to craft a fully customized itinerary that suits your style—whether you love history, food, hidden gems, or cultural experiences.
This private tour is a walking experience. A private vehicle is not included.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
San Francisco is a city of striking contrasts, where waterfront history meets creative energy and diverse neighborhoods shape its identity. With your local host, you will go beyond the obvious sights and experience the city through its stories, scenic piers, and the everyday moments that bring it to life.

Before the tour begins, you will complete a short online questionnaire so we can match you with the right local host to design your ideal San Francisco experience.
